conditions.pulsed_note: Note E: <300 ms pulses, duty cycle 0.5% max

curve_identification: Visually inspected rendered Figure 2: lower-voltage turn-on curve is 125 C; rightward turn-on is 25 C. Drawing indices 8 and 7 respectively.
method: Sample exact PDF cubic Bezier centerline paths; no raster pixel digitization, model fit, extrapolation or hardware.
limitations: A centerline is graphical data, not original manufacturer measurements; extra stored precision is for reproducibility only.
The full 1.76-point stroke spans about 0.285 A on this axis. The 0.2 A crossing is consequently poorly resolved; display approximate values only.
This VDS=-5 V curve is not actual camera current versus gate voltage on a 3.7 V LiPo. Current also depends on drain-source voltage and load state.
Gate-to-ground translation VG=VS-|VGS| assumes fixed source VS. It does not change the source curve test condition.
3.7 V/2.2 ohm=1.682 A is an ideal resistor-only ceiling with zero board voltage and zero switch drop, not expected operating current.
No board simulation or measurement and no kit-device characterization.
